title: Our school. Our community. Our PTO.
intro: Welcome to the Parent–Teacher Organization for Thrive Center for Success.
boardTitle: Led by our board and our members
boardBody: The Thrive PTO is led by a PTO Board and its members. Some important PTO decisions and changes require a membership vote, giving members a voice in what comes next.
volunteerTitle: There's a place for your contribution
volunteerBody: Whether you have an hour to give or want to take on a larger role, we'd love to have you join us—but there's never any pressure. Every contribution is appreciated.
contactBody: If you run into any issues or have questions about your PTO membership, please reach out to us. We're happy to help get you connected!
